title: How to Get the Best Price for Your South Tampa Home
topic: How to get the best price for your South Tampa home
gbp_post:
Most South Tampa sellers focus on list price. The data says that is the wrong starting point.

Homes in Hyde Park, Palma Ceia, and Davis Islands that sell at or above asking price share a pattern. They entered the market in tight condition, were priced within about two percent of their likely appraisal value, and hit the MLS on a Thursday or Friday with professional photos already live. That sequence is not accidental.

Days on market is the number buyers watch most closely. A home that sits ten days longer than comparable properties on Bayshore Boulevard or in the South Howard corridor attracts lower offers, not higher ones. Buyers read days on market as leverage.

Condition drives this more than any single renovation. Fresh interior paint, corrected deferred maintenance, and a clean inspection report remove the objections buyers use to justify low offers. A seller who addresses those items before listing does not give up negotiating ground.

Pricing strategy matters too. Homes in Palma Ceia priced just above a natural search threshold, say $1,050,000 instead of $999,000, often see fewer showings in the first week, which is the week that matters most.

The best final price is almost always built before the sign goes in the yard.
